info.name: WhatsApp Workflow Automation API - v1
info.description:
API documentation for the WhatsApp Workflow Automation project. This collection is intended for Flutter mobile developers to integrate authentication and core features.

### Authentication
The API uses Laravel Sanctum for bearer token authentication. Use the **Auth > Login** request to obtain a token, which will be automatically saved to the `auth_token` environment variable.

request.description:
Authenticates a user and returns a bearer token. The token is required for all protected routes.

**Body Parameters:**
- `email`: Required. User's email address.
- `password`: Required. User's password (min 8 chars).
- `device_name`: Optional. Identifier for the token.

request.description:
Creates a new WhatsApp template and submits it for review. If using a media header (image, video, document), you must provide a sample file.

**Fields:**
- `name`: Alphanumeric and underscores only.
- `category`: marketing, utility, authentication.
- `language_code`: e.g. en_US, pt_BR.
- `header_type`: none, text, image, video, document.
- `header_text`: Required if header_type is text.
- `body_text`: The main message content. Use {{1}} for variables.
- `footer_text`: Optional footer.
- `buttons`: Array of button objects.
- `example_payload`: Samples for variables in header/body.
Updates an existing template. Note: Approved templates on Meta have limited update capabilities. This often triggers a re-review.
Returns full details of a specific WhatsApp template.
